newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wanfang to launch initial public offer on Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: Wanfang to launch initial public offer on Sept 9.

text.p: Henan-based Jiaozuo Wanfang Aluminium Industry Co Ltd said on Friday that it is set to launch an offer of 32.01 million class A shares on September 9.
The offer, which has been approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, would be priced at 6.80 yuan per share, the firm said in an offer prospectus.

The issue has a prospective price/earnings ratio of 13.33 times based on forecast net earnings of 0.51 yuan per share for 1996, said the notice, which was published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Guotai Securities has been appointed the chief underwriter for the offer.
Wangfang said that it aims to list the A shares on the Shenzhen bourse by the end of this month.

The company said that following the A share offer, it would have expanded share capital of 124.837 million shares, including 74.527 million promoter shares, 15 million staff shares and 3.30 million legal person shares.
Wanfang plans to channel the proceeds from the issue of class A stock, which is reserved for mainland Chinese investors, into its core business -- aluminium processing.
Wanfang, based in Jiaozuo in central Henan province, has forecast net earnings of 63 million yuan for this year, compared with 47.32 million yuan posted in 1995 and 26.01 million yuan a year earlier.
The company said it aims to meet the earnings growth target through moves to upgrade production technology and expand output of aluminium.
